spanish.r-long.c1.0011.problem: Factual error: Elisa is from Santander, which is on the north coast of Spain, not 'en el centro del país' (the basis of part k).
spanish.r-long.c1.0011.fix: Make her from Madrid (or Valladolid), or change the last line to 'Mi ciudad está en la costa norte y tiene buenas conexiones', adjusting (k).

spanish.r-long.c2.0012.problem: Factual error: Andrés is from Sevilla, but the text says his region's summers are not very hot; Seville has famously very hot summers (basis of part h).
spanish.r-long.c2.0012.fix: Change the city to one with a mild climate (e.g. Santander or A Coruña), or rewrite (h) as 'en verano hace muchísimo calor'.

spanish.r-long.e1.0001.problem: Implausible context: Paula is from Caracas (a native Spanish speaker), yet she finds Spanish pronunciation of the 'erre' hard, and in Cusco she did not understand anything because people spoke fast; the mark scheme ('Refuse el español') assumes she is learning Spanish.
spanish.r-long.e1.0001.fix: Make her from a non-Spanish-speaking city (e.g. Lisboa / Londres), or make the difficulty another language (e.g. la pronunciación del francés) and the exchange in a non-Spanish-speaking country.
